answer: Sealed task receipts stop Sybil attacks in four steps. First, a new agent must finish ten jobs, each checked by a different peer. Second, each job leaves a sealed receipt of task and checker, so history cannot be invented. Third, idle agents lose reputation like a melting glacier, so bought accounts decay. Fourth, a caught fake loses all receipts and restarts. Faking one thousand agents needs ten thousand verified jobs and about $6,000 in fees, wasted if caught. Trust grows like a voyage, and onyx keeps value because it cannot be faked fast, like a vendor earning regulars daily.
